nodes.id: docs_html页面替换qt页面实施计划_robotsnapshot
nodes.label: RobotSnapshot
nodes.source_file: docs/HTML页面替换Qt页面实施计划.md
nodes.description: Unified data model for all pages: connection, system, position, motion, io, diagnostics. Serves as the single source of truth for frontend state across all dashboard views.

nodes.id: docs_html页面替换qt页面实施计划_htmltoqtmigration
nodes.label: HTML-to-Qt Migration Plan
nodes.source_file: docs/HTML页面替换Qt页面实施计划.md
nodes.description: Plan to replace PySide6 Qt pages with React/HTML frontend via local HTTP/WebSocket. Three-layer architecture: Desktop entry layer, Web page layer, Python control service layer. 8 implementation phases (F1-F4 frontend, B1-B8 backend).

nodes.label: Three-Layer Architecture
nodes.source_file: docs/HTML页面替换Qt页面实施计划.md
nodes.description: Architecture with Desktop entry layer (Qt shell or browser), Web page layer (React/HTML), and Python control service layer (REST + WebSocket). Separates UI rendering from robot control logic.

nodes.id: docs_html页面替换qt页面实施计划_apidesign
nodes.label: REST + WebSocket API Design
nodes.source_file: docs/HTML页面替换Qt页面实施计划.md
nodes.description: API design with REST endpoints for CRUD operations and WebSocket for real-time telemetry streaming. Supports RobotSnapshot, DashboardState, ActionPlan, PrecheckResult, ExecutionState, ConversationEvent, AlarmEvent data models.

nodes.id: docs_html页面替换qt页面实施计划_jsonschematypes
nodes.label: JSON Schema Types A/B/C
nodes.source_file: docs/HTML页面替换Qt页面实施计划.md
nodes.description: Three JSON schema types for WebSocket communication: Type A CommandIntent (user commands), Type B InteractionRecord (conversation history), Type C DeviceSnapshot (robot state telemetry).

nodes.label: EXE Packaging Strategy
nodes.source_file: docs/HTML页面替换Qt页面实施计划.md
nodes.description: Two-phase packaging: first browser mode (system default browser as UI shell), then Qt WebEngine shell for integrated single-window experience. Minimizes distribution complexity.
